archetypes.name: allowlist-auditor
archetypes.rationale: Validate that embedded quiet logging cannot run before design tmpdir allowlist checks.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the regenerated legacy assets with a security lens. Check every execution path that can initialize quiet logging or touch DESIGN_TMPDIR, especially run-step3 review, retally, timing, and preview-only behavior. Confirm validation fails closed where intended and warning-oriented preview paths do not write before validation. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: asset-roundtrip
archetypes.rationale: The changed blobs must preserve raw retired markers and runtime substitution behavior.
archetypes.prompt_body: Inspect the _LEGACY_ASSETS regeneration for raw/runtime drift. Pay close attention to dispatch-plan-voters and dispatch-plan-review-panel, where raw blobs must keep retired waterfall shell markers while legacy_asset_bytes still substitutes the runtime agent dispatcher. Check that tests cover both views without hard-coding retired path literals. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
